title: skills: teach the save notice in the objectstack-data lifecycle rule
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibx5r5nhDMwpRs4SL6D

Filing gate: ③ the `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line of PR #28247 (#28000), filed by the seat before ACCEPT as the claim template requires. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the lane and grade.
Reach: an AI author writing a save hook from the `objectstack-data` skill does not learn that a hook can tell the user what the save started, so it keeps reaching for a `record:alert` banner.

## Wanted

- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/lifecycle.md` teaches the save notice: one message, info severity, last call wins, shown with the save toast; distinct from validation `warnings`.
- Lands with or after the server card for #28000 (the sandboxed hook-context spelling), since today only a code handler can set it. Governed path (`skills/**`): Tier H.

Links back: #28000, PR #28247.

Blocked-by: #28251
